verdict.rationale: Revenue recognition is a fair question for an invoicing and billing product, but the evidence pack never mentions ASC 606/IFRS 15, deferred revenue schedules, or recognition reports. The documented reports cover payment patterns, sales, receivables and expenses, and the Zoho Books integration belongs to a separate product, so neither counts toward this story.

support.subject: As a finance lead, revenue is recognized on an ASC 606 / IFRS 15 basis — deferred revenue schedules and audit-ready recognition reports straight from billing data
